run_dbir_submission: run a DBIR challenge submission for CO3Dv2 across all tasks and sequence sets
create_dataset_map: create a dataset map for a CO3Dv2 category and subset using JsonIndexDatasetMapProviderV2
update_submission_predictions: update a CO3DSubmission with DBIR predictions for a specific category and subset
render_point_cloud: render a point cloud from depth maps and cameras using dbir_utils for new view synthesis
submit_to_eval_ai: submit CO3D challenge results to the EvalAI evaluation server via the CLI interface
